newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Bahrain 91-day t-bill rate climbs to 5.75 pct.
newsitem.headline: Bahrain 91-day t-bill rate climbs to 5.75 pct.

text.p: The average yield at this week's tender for 10 million dinars of 91-day Bahrain treasury bills climbed to 5.75 percent from 5.74 percent last week, a spokesman for the Bahrain Monetary Agency said on Monday.
The average price declined to 98.567 from 98.570 and the minimum price accepted was also 98.567 compared with 98.554 last week.
Banks submitted bids for 26.20 million dinars worth of bills, down from 28.70 million dinars last week.
The bills, maturing on September 10, were offered on Monday and will be issued on Wednesday.
